name: Entity Template
description: Store reusable templates of entities (with tokenised/Twig field values) and create new entities from them through a builder flow.
project_description: Entity Template stores reusable templates of entities. A template is a set of components that populate a target entity's fields; component values can be static input or tokenised/Twig strings resolved from typed-data contexts and builder parameters. Templates are grouped into blueprints under a builder, and a multi-step build flow (parameters -> select blueprint -> entity edit form) produces a new pre-filled entity. Plugin types (builder, template, component, blueprint provider) make the system extensible; the optional Entity Template UI submodule provides the admin configuration UI. Depends on the contributed Typed Data module.
